_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wee Player {player_id} kwa Tic Tac Toe.
Lakelo kuwe ni kusewe mara thik three (kwa mlalo, wima, au mlalo kando) kwenye bodi.
Kwenye muda wako, unapaswa kuchagua nambari ya mraba (0-8) unataka kuweka alama yako inayofuata.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' huweka alama yako katikati ya seli ya bodi.
Kama Player {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ok en cell maber. Nyaka obed e kind 0 kod 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} en gima osebed ka itiyo godo.
